title: TIC 144439305.01: a 1.1 Earth-radius, 22.6-hour transiting planet candidate around a nearby M dwarf
description:
Independent discovery and vetting of a transiting planet candidate around the M dwarf TIC 144439305 (Gaia DR3 6532568669359184000; 62 pc), found in public NASA TESS full-frame-image data.

  • Period 0.9398098 d (22.6 h); radius 1.12 ± 0.08 Earth radii; depth 489 ppm; T14 1.02 h.
  • Seen in every TESS sector covering the star (2020–2026); confirmed in independent light curves (own photometry 7.7σ, TESS-SPOC 6.3σ).
  • Pre-registered test on unsearched TESS sectors 105–106 (prediction SHA-256 7c9ad78233b91b76aa40728cc33c18a4d0e4bcb316d20fec71a4c2f298bed688): recovered at 6.4σ (473 ± 74 ppm).
  • PRF difference-image fits place the source on the target; TRICERATOPS false-positive probability 0.0092 with MOLUSC Gaia companion limits (0.062 without), NFPP 0.0044.

Status: planet candidate ("likely planet"), not validated or confirmed; high-resolution imaging and radial velocities are needed. As of 2026-11-20 the star is not a TOI or CTOI. Includes the write-up, data products, figures, predicted transit times through 2027 and the full search and vetting code. Search and vetting were carried out with Claude (Anthropic) at the author's direction.

Web page: https://rajmeet.github.io/TIC144439305/
